is: The Zurfur-specific runner around the extracted `sqlx-rust-codegen` library — boots a throwaway Postgres, migrates it with the real embedded migration set, describes every statement under `adapter-pg`'s and `adapter-atproto`'s `queries/` trees, and rewrites each crate's committed `src/queries.rs`.
conventions: The `codegen_current` staleness test that shares this crate's config lives in the adapter crates, not here.
The workspace build never invokes this binary — it runs only on demand.
entry_points: src/main.rs (just gen-queries, boots testcontainers Postgres and regenerates both adapters)

fs.name: src/
fs.role: config + runner binary (lib.rs config, main.rs bin)
